payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP with convex hull trick (deque) to optimize min over previous states: dp[i] = min_{j<i} dp[j] + b[j] * a[i].
payload.rationale: The solution maintains a one-dimensional DP array where dp[i] depends on previous dp[j]. The use of CHT with a deque to efficiently compute the minimum confirms it's a 1D state DP, not 2D or other variants.
